frozen_gates:
# Cardinal neighbor lookup reuse: frozen trial gates

Recorded before any new build, measurements or production edit, 2026-10-07 UTC.

Only production target: Tomogram::connect. Four stack-local lazy memo slots may reuse cardinal neighbor_in results within one cell. Preserve first evaluation order, neighbor order, all checkpoint positions/count/order, float expressions and directed compatibility tests. No allocation/BFS/cost/search/cache/owner change. Keep retained single-pass masked construction.

A/A stability control before production edit: three fresh baseline processes, identical reference/current connect operations in each, 4 paired warmups then 32 pairs alternating first version. Connect median current/reference must be in [0.95,1.05], and each process ratio in [0.90,1.10]. Compare exact maps/routes outside timers. If gate fails, stop production trial and record inconclusive environment/control, without selecting samples or enlarging runs.

Correctness gate: original connect body frozen verbatim in test-only reference; exact cell scalar bits and ordered adjacency/column indices, known columns, routes and work counts match. Explicit no-corner-cut, multilayer nearest tie, directional step, ceiling, missing vs known-empty, negative coordinate and cancellation checkpoint tests must pass. Existing all PCT tests and direct/detour/penalty zero/full stack path checks must pass. Any correctness mismatch rejects production change.

Performance schedule if A/A passes: exactly seven fresh baseline/candidate process pairs, AB/BA alternating. Each connect process includes 4 warmup pairs and 32 timed pairs on fixed mixed_80x64 topology; separately time complete construction (16 repeats with input clone included, returned map destruction excluded). Also run existing calibrated zero/full direct/detour/penalty selector in each baseline/candidate process pair, recording cold/warm and all path bits. No parallel heavy job. Same SDK, mixed profile (PCT/stack opt0, MLS/runtime opt3), assertions/overflow enabled, no release profile retry.

Retain only if: median of seven process-level candidate/reference connect ratios <=0.95 and connect candidate faster in at least 6/7 processes; median paired complete-construction candidate/baseline <=0.97 and faster in at least 5/7 pairs; each noncancelled body_path case/budget cold and warm median paired ratio <=1.05. Timing ratios are diagnostics, not hardware or movement qualification. Failed performance or stability gate means restore only the trial production delta byte-exactly, preserve tests/evidence and report no demonstrated gain. No omitted outliers or altered gates after seeing data.

No transport, AF_UNIX, motion, controller or actual robot runs. No commits, branches, pushes or network writes.
independent_audit:
# Independent read-only audit

2026-10-07 UTC. Reviewer: separate read-only cardinal-lookup trial agent.

Production diff review passes with no correctness blocker. The four slots are lazy Option<Option<usize>> values, so both resolved IDs and misses are reused only within one source cell. Original first-use lookup order, dx-major/dy-minor neighbor emission, asymmetric flank-to-diagonal compatibility, Vec capacity, and all checkpoint sites remain intact. Cache-hit cardinal distance is safe for constructor-valid finite positive resolution: resolution*sqrt(1) is bit-identical to resolution; original distance expressions remain evaluated. No persistent caching, BFS/cost/allocation change or single-pass-adapter change was introduced.

The first ceiling fixture was found not to isolate finite-ceiling rejection. Before the production trial it was strengthened to assert that both lower cells survive construction, the step is allowed, and finite shared headroom alone rejects the cardinal edge. A separate exact-tie fixture proves that selecting the alternative upper flank would wrongly open a diagonal. The cancellation oracle compares result and partially written adjacency at every checkpoint on a 4x4 graph. This is deterministic checkpoint/partial-state equivalence, not a wall-clock cancellation-latency guarantee.

Independent raw-log reparse confirms retention gate passes: 28 unique scheduled processes, all exit 0 with passing test footer; log hashes match; connect median candidate/frozen-reference ratio 0.6357742949531098 (36.42% reduction), 7/7 faster; construction paired C/B median 0.8190994880598632 (18.09%), 7/7 faster. All 12 frozen path median-ratio guards pass. Verified 42 cross-arm path-evidence arrays and quality records equal, plus 21 stage-probe cells/expanded/chord-clear records equal. Four frozen binary SHA-256s match and all 264 build profile/feature entries match.

Final reporting caveats independently checked: the reductions use medians of seven process-level ratios, not ratios of group medians or operation percentiles. Warm-path median guards pass but direct warm individual ratios reach 2.9568 and 2.7580; this does not establish tail-latency nonregression. All 28 wait4 ru_maxrss records are 41,820 KiB; no memory saving claim is supported. The 42 serialized bit-exact cross-arm paths are cold paths. Cold/warm and zero/full checks use whole-path PartialEq, not independent warm bit serialization. Qualification is 24 PCT functional tests plus the repeated stack selector, not full-workspace or hardware qualification. Reviewer recommends retaining the candidate under the frozen gates.

Final document review: all seven timing-table rows independently match raw totals/repetition counts, all six path-median rows match, companion JSON preserves every audited SUMMARY field and all 28 process records, and 12 protected source hashes still match. The report distinguishes process-ratio medians, warm outliers, cold bit serialization versus warm PartialEq and the masked oracle shared-constructor limitation. Clarified that only the 14 connect processes run both connect variants.
